# CodeTeak

> CodeTeak (Codeteak Technologies) is a software studio founded in 2025, building innovative web and mobile applications, SaaS products, and end-to-end IT solutions for startups and enterprises. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India with a presence in Dubai, UAE.

CodeTeak transforms ideas into scalable digital products across retail, e-commerce, logistics, supermarkets, and growth-stage startups. The team delivers custom software engineering, product design, cyber security, cloud infrastructure, and in-house SaaS products including Yaadro (delivery management) and Lens (AI face-recognition attendance).

**Contact:** info@codeteak.com | **Phone:** +91 99952 03149 | **Website:** https://codeteak.com

**Stats:** 100+ projects delivered · 50+ active clients · 95% client satisfaction · 25+ partners

**Technologies:** React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, React Native, Flutter, AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices

## Products

- [Yaadro](https://codeteak.com/products/yaadro): Delivery management system connecting supermarkets, delivery partners, and customers with mobile apps and web dashboard
- [Lens (YaadroLens)](https://codeteak.com/products/lens): AI-powered face recognition attendance system for retail stores with 90%+ accuracy and offline-first architecture
- [Yaadro Ecommerce](https://codeteak.com/products/ecommerce): Supermarket ecommerce platform with online ordering and Cash on Delivery (COD) checkout

## Services

### Cyber Security
- Threat Detection & Prevention: AI-powered real-time cyber threat identification and neutralization
- Fraud Prevention & Detection: Pattern analysis to prevent financial fraud and unauthorized access
- Security Audit & Compliance: Security assessments and regulatory compliance checks
- Network Security: Firewall management, intrusion detection, and secure network architecture
- Data Protection & Encryption: End-to-end encryption and secure data storage and transmission
- Incident Response & Recovery: Rapid breach mitigation, investigation, and system restoration

### Product Engineering
- Backend Development: Scalable server-side architecture and APIs
- Frontend Development: Responsive, intuitive user interfaces across all devices
- Cloud Infrastructure: Scalable cloud solutions on AWS, Azure, and similar platforms
- DevOps & CI/CD: Automated workflows and deployment pipelines
- Microservices Architecture: Modular, maintainable independent services
- API Development: Secure, well-documented REST and GraphQL APIs

### Product Design
- UI Design: Visually cohesive interfaces aligned with brand identity
- UX Design: User-centered, accessible experience design
- Prototyping: Interactive prototypes for concept validation
- Design Systems: Comprehensive design systems for team consistency
- User Research: Data-driven design decisions from user behavior research
- Accessibility Design: WCAG-compliant design for all users

### Additional Capabilities
- Web Development: Modern, responsive, scalable web applications
- Mobile App Development: Native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps
- AI Integration Systems: Machine learning and AI capabilities for existing workflows
- Team Augmentation: Seamless integration with client development teams
- Performance Optimization: Application speed and efficiency improvements
- Security & Compliance: Enterprise-grade security solutions
